![Demystifying Hair Growth Phases: Complete Guide](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/10181626-2787-0139-0000-9748d06b6027:4)
The human hair growth cycle consists of four main stages: [`anagen (growth), catagen (transition), telogen (resting), and exogen (shedding)`].[[1]](https://www.advancedhair.com/learn/understanding-the-hair-growth-cycle)

### 1. Anagen Phase (Growth Phase)

- **Duration:** 2 to 7 years.
- **Percentage of hair:** 85% to 90% of scalp hair.
- **What happens:** Cells divide fast at the hair root. The hair shaft grows longer. This phase decides how long your hair can get.[[1]](https://www.advancedhair.com/learn/understanding-the-hair-growth-cycle)

### 2. Catagen Phase (Transition Phase)

- **Duration:** 2 to 3 weeks.
- **Percentage of hair:** 1% to 2% of scalp hair.
- **What happens:** Growth stops. The hair follicle shrinks. The hair detaches from the blood supply and becomes a "club hair".[[1]](https://crossplasticsurgery.com/growth-cycle.html)[[2]](https://www.advancedhair.com/learn/understanding-the-hair-growth-cycle)

### 3. Telogen Phase (Resting Phase)

- **Duration:** 2 to 4 months.
- **Percentage of hair:** 10% to 15% of scalp hair.
- **What happens:** The hair rests inside the follicle while a new hair starts to form underneath it.[[1]](https://www.hairtransplantfue.org/blog/hair-growth-cycle)[[2]](https://www.advancedhair.com/learn/understanding-the-hair-growth-cycle)

### 4. Exogen Phase (Shedding Phase)

- **Duration:** Overlaps with the telogen phase.
- **What happens:** Old hairs fall out of the follicle. Losing 50 to 100 hairs a day is normal during this time. After the hair sheds, the cycle restarts at the anagen phase.[[1]](https://www.advancedhair.com/learn/understanding-the-hair-growth-cycle)[[2]](https://www.hairtransplantfue.org/blog/hair-growth-cycle)

You can read more about hair biology on [Wikipedia's Human Hair Growth](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Human_hair_growth) page or explore tips for [Healthline's Stages of Hair Growth](https://www.healthline.com/health/stages-of-hair-growth).[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Human_hair_growth)[[2]](https://www.healthline.com/health/stages-of-hair-growth)
